subject: Pilot structure & launch credit proposal for LumenHealth — hosted API pricing
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Andrea Santos <andrea.santos@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot structure: launch credits + per-token discounts for LumenHealth

Hi Andrea —

Great speaking with you this morning. Per our call, attached is a concise proposal for a scoped 8-week pilot and an optional launch incentive tied to a paid commit. High-level summary below:

- Pilot (POC): 8 weeks, up to 100k free generation-equivalent tokens (applies to text generation only; embeddings billed separately). Free credits will be applied to Hosted API usage and expire 90 days after issuance.
- Launch incentive (time-limited): One-time launch credit applied on signed commit. Standard offer: $10,000 USD in platform credits for a 12-month commitment at a $25k/month minimum (billed monthly).
- Commit tiers / per-token discounts (post-commit):
  • $25k/mo (12 mo) — 30% per-token discount on generation
  • $50k/mo (12 mo) — 40% per-token discount on generation
  • Enterprise >$150k/mo — custom pricing
- What the credits cover: Hosted API usage (generation tokens + streaming); credits cannot be applied to dedicated/private deployment fees, professional services, or one-time setup.
- Metering notes: embeddings are billed separately and have a separate slab; we can include embeddings credit in a bespoke proposal if requested.
- Compliance: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II-compliant; happy to provide evidence and a security questionnaire (I can loop in our security team).

Next steps: if this looks reasonable, I can send a one-page MOU and payment terms; we can also schedule a short follow-up to review integration constraints and rate limits.

Attaching: LH_Pilot_Proposal_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Andrea Santos <andrea.santos@lumenhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Nguyen <kate@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot structure: launch credits + per-token discounts for LumenHealth

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the PDF. A few clarifying questions from the procurement/engineering side before we move to an MOU:

1) Are the per-token discounts retroactive to pilot usage once a commit is signed, or do discounts apply only to consumption after the commit effective date?
2) You mentioned embeddings are billed separately. Can you provide the embeddings slab and confirm whether embedding usage can draw from the "free credits" in the pilot or launch incentive?
3) Is there an explicit monthly usage cap during the pilot to prevent runaway bills, or should we rely on token ceilings only?
4) Our security team will want SOC2 evidence and the data retention policy. Can you attach the SOC2 report and a short summary of retention/audit log options?
5) If we sign a 6-month pilot-level commit (smaller than 12 mo), do you have a scaled credit/incentive?

We like the approach but need answers to the above to get internal approval. Also can you confirm whether credits expire 90 days after issuance? That will affect whether credits are usable for a staged rollout.

Best,
Andrea Santos
Director, Digital Platforms | LumenHealth
andrea.santos@lumenhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0189

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Andrea Santos <andrea.santos@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot structure: launch credits + per-token discounts for LumenHealth

Hi Andrea —

Thanks — great questions. Answers inline below, and I attached a short MOU draft and the pricing slab CSV for your procurement team to review.

1) Discounts timing: discounts on per-token rates apply to consumption after the commit effective date. We do not retroactively apply the post-commit discount to consumption prior to the signed start date. However, credits issued as a launch incentive can be applied to earlier pilot consumption if agreed in the MOU (we can carve that in).

2) Embeddings: standard embeddings slab is included in the attached pricing-slabs.csv. Embeddings are not part of the 100k generation-equivalent pilot credit by default, but we can include up to $2,000 in embeddings credit in the pilot package upon request.

3) Pilot caps: we set a hard token ceiling of 100k tokens for the pilot. We can enable per-day alerts and an automatic stop (cutoff) if consumption approaches 95% of the cap — that is standard for these pilots.

4) SOC 2 & retention: attaching our SOC 2 Type II summary and a one-page retention notes doc (if you want the full report we can execute an NDA). We keep request-level audit logs for 90 days by default; longer retention is available as an add-on.

5) Scaled commit: for a 6-month commit we can offer a scaled incentive — typically 50% of the 12-month launch credit (so $5k credits on a $25k/mo 6-month commit), but we prefer 12-months for the full incentive.

Credits expiration: yes, credits issued as part of the standard pilot or launch incentive expire 90 days after issuance unless we explicitly specify a different window in the MOU.

Attached: LH_Pilot_MOU_draft.docx, pricing-slabs.csv, SOC2_Summary.pdf

If you're comfortable, I'll circulate the one-page MOU and a procurement-friendly statement of work for signature.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Andrea — credit exception request

Forwarding Andrea's questions — procurement is asking about expanding the launch incentive. Andrea is pushing for the $10k + the ability to apply credits retroactively to pilot consumption (so the credits would backfill some pilot overage). Procurement also asked whether we can extend credit expiry to 180 days to accommodate their staged rollout calendar.

My take: the standard playbook is $10k for 12-mo $25k/m minimum and credits expire 90 days. I can be flexible on a small increase if finance signs off. Marcus — do you have margin/finance guidance for a one-off increase to $15k and extended expiry? Lauren — do you want to offer a counter: $12k credits + 20% discount for first 3 months post-launch instead of extending expiry?

Proposed internal options: 
- Option A (standard): $10k credits, 90-day expiry, discounts per the slab attached
- Option B (compromise): $12k credits, 120-day expiry, 20% off first 3 months post-launch
- Option C (aggressive): $15k credits, 180-day expiry, 30% off first 6 months (requires finance/leadership sign-off)

FYI attaching the pilot proposal and MOU draft for context.

Regards,
Vanessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
